name: Grassy Key RV Park & Resort
note: Small resort of about 36 RV sites with a boat basin. It books a site type, not a site number, by phone or email (there is no online booking), it takes no arrivals after 4:30 pm, and every RV must carry the RVIA seal. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site grassykeyrvpark.com read 2026-10-30: full-hookup 30/50-amp Standard to Deluxe Waterfront RV sites for 'RVs and motorcoaches of all sizes', a 2026-27 rate sheet (updated 4-1-26) posting daily, weekly and monthly rates, a numbered site map (1-34, A, B), open year round, phone 305-289-1606; RV Life reviews of nightly and weekly stays in Dec 2025, Jan, Mar and May 2026 (one says 'just 36 sites'); Good Sam directory types it RV_PARK (a Good Sam Park), not a condo park; no homes or lots for sale; Google Maps open, 4.5/314, phone matches -> real transient RV resort; price gate lifted: Florida Keys zone (AWH 2026-10-30, gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-30: the operator's resort map (MAP_MASTER Handout 7-21 on grassykeyrvpark.com/resort-map) puts Waterfront sites 1-3 on a sand strip with palms directly on the Gulf (Florida Bay) shore, and sites 4-10, A and B around the A and B boat basins; that only triggered the audit. The Esri satellite (sat.py, rendered: 220 m frame at 24.7653,-80.9488 and 110 m frame at 24.7655,-80.9488) shows the park's NW edge on open Florida Bay (open salt water to the horizon on the 800 m frame, not a canal): the RVs on sites 1-3 park nose-on to the shore on open sand, about 6 m from the riprap edge and roughly 15-20 m from the open bay flats, with no road, lot or treeline between, so the campground's own frontage is an open apron within the distance bound. The boat basins are a short dredged harbor whose north wall is the bay shoreline and which opens onto the bay at its NW corner, with the bay in view over the wall, so sites 4-10 facing them across the sand walkway are on bay water too. The interior rows (11-34) sit inland behind the waterfront rows.
fees_source: https://www.grassykeyrvpark.com/rate-reserv-policies, rate sheet '2026-27 Rates 4-1-26' (image), read 2026-10-30: daily rates for 4 people, 1 RV, 1 vehicle, before 12.5% site tax, any rig. Winter Dec 15-Apr 14 (in season): Standard $170, Standard Plus $185, Premium $215, Waterfront $250, Deluxe Waterfront $285. Summer Apr 15-Dec 14: Standard $105 up to Deluxe Waterfront $205. No resort or grounds fee listed. Bookings are by phone/email, so no engine quote was run.

booking.note: 3-night minimum on holidays and special events, which are also charged at winter rates.

booking_source: https://www.grassykeyrvpark.com/rate-reserv-policies rate sheet updated 4-1-26, read 2026-10-30: 'Winter rates apply on holidays & special events (3-day min.)'
flags: Cheapest in-season (winter, Dec 15-Apr 14) night is $170 before 12.5% tax (Standard site); summer from $105.
No online booking engine: reservations are by phone (305-289-1606) or email, paid in full when booked; a daily booking cancelled 5+ days out still loses a $95 admin fee.
Minimum stay: only the 3-night holiday and 'special events' minimum on the rate sheet; no standing minimum, and RV Life reviewers paid nightly rates in Dec 2025, Jan 2026 and Mar 2026.

About 36 sites (site map 1-34 plus A and B; a May 2026 RV Life reviewer says 36). Weekly, monthly, 4-month and 6-month lease rates also exist; no count of how many sites go to long stays, and the 2025-26 reviews are of nightly and weekly stays.
Good Sam Park (isGsPark true, military true) per the Good Sam directory cache; the operator's rate page offers Good Sam members 10% off the daily rate.
House rules: check-in 12-4:30 pm with no late arrivals, 4 people and 1 RV + 1 vehicle per site, RVs must display the RVIA seal (EKKO, a factory Class C, has one).
Open-Meteo DEM gives 0 m at the pin (1-3 m on nearby points).
